values.note: County fee schedule (current page, undated): interior sites $20 a night, waterfront sites $25; primitive tent sites $12.50; $3 off for seniors 65+ and disabled. The park charges a $5 per vehicle per day parking fee (annual pass $35), paid at the entrance paybox.

fees.source: https://www.co.pickens.sc.us/departments/parks,_recreation,___tourism/mile_creek_park/fee_schedule.php ('Camping Fee (per night) Waterfront Sites $25.00 Interior Sites $20.00'; 'Discount for Seniors (65 & Older) & Disabled $3.00') + about.php ('a parking fee of $5 per vehicle per day'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Booked on ReserveAmerica ('Reservations can be made on this website only'). 'Maximum stay of 14 days on one site, and maximum of 28 days total', then 14 days out of the park. One camper and one tent (or two tents), 2 vehicles and 8 people per site; a camping unit must be set up at check-in.

booking.source: https://www.reserveamerica.com/explore/mile-creek-county-park/PRCG/1063450/overview ('MILE CREEK COUNTY PARK is now taking advanced reservations. Reservations can be made on this website only') + rules___regulations.php ('Maximum stay of 14 days on one site, and maximum of 28 days total'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Every site has water and electric (amperage not stated). The rules require all sewage and grey water to go to a dump station.

hookups.source: https://www.co.pickens.sc.us/departments/parks,_recreation,___tourism/mile_creek_park/amenities.php ('Each of our 69 campsites, whether waterfront of water view, has water and electric hookups') + rules___regulations.php ('All liquid waste, including sewage and grey water, must be collected and disposed of at a designated dump station'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 69 waterfront and interior campsites, plus primitive tent sites, a group camping area and 10 lakefront cabins.

sites.source: https://www.co.pickens.sc.us/departments/parks,_recreation,___tourism/mile_creek_park/amenities.php ('Each of our 69 campsites, whether waterfront of water view') + fee_schedule.php, read 2026-10-21

values.note: Three heated comfort stations with hot showers; two dump stations.

facilities.source: https://www.co.pickens.sc.us/departments/parks,_recreation,___tourism/mile_creek_park/amenities.php ('three heated comfort stations, each with restroom facilities, sinks, mirrors and hot-water showers'; 'A sewage dump station is available within the park') + ReserveAmerica overview ('two dump stations are available'), read 2026-10-21

note: Pickens County park on Lake Keowee near Six Mile; more than two-thirds of the campsites have direct shoreline access. Three boat ramps and a 150-ft dock. --Claude
summary: County pages: fees added $20 interior / $25 waterfront (senior/disabled $3 off; $5/day parking fee); booking added ReserveAmerica (reservations online only), 14 nights per site / 28 total; confirmed water at all 69 sites (amps not stated), showers and dump.
